generate_crowd_sourced_data: generate synthetic crowd-sourced annotation data with configurable labelers, categories, and correctness priors
evaluate_posterior_predictive_likelihood: evaluate the posterior predictive likelihood of test items against posterior samples from the model
create_dirichlet_confusion_matrices: create per-labeler confusion matrices sampled from a Dirichlet prior based on expected correctness
review_crowd_sourced_annotation_model: review the CrowdSourcedAnnotation class and its generative model for inferring true labels from imperfect annotators
summarize_crowd_sourced_annotation: summarize the CrowdSourcedAnnotation model including hyperparameters, generative process, and posterior sample structure
